source: Z. Wang, X. Mu, Y. Liu, "Near-Field Integrated Sensing and Communications", arXiv:2302.01153v5 (23 Sep 2025), Fig. 2 and Fig. 4
method: Vector path extraction from the PDF with linear/logarithmic tick calibration
limitations: Displayed plot coordinates, not raw author data; allow rounding error.

files.paper_fig2.csv: RCRB vs minimum rate R_min (wide format: FD/HB x distance [m] / angle [deg])
files.paper_fig4.csv: RCRB vs target distance r_s at R_min = 5 bit/s/Hz (long format, near-field curves)
